"def test_unset_in_default_map(runner):
    """An ``UNSET`` value in ``default_map`` should be treated as if
    the key is absent, and so fallback to the parameter's own default.

    Refs: https://github.com/pallets/click/pull/3224#issuecomment-3968643305
    """

    @click.command(
        context_settings={"default_map": {"port": UNSET}},
    )
    @click.option("--port", default=8000)
    def cli(port):
        click.echo(f"port={port}")

    result = runner.invoke(cli, [])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output.strip() == "port=8000"


def test_default_map_multi_value_option(runner):
    """Multi-value options (nargs > 1) with string values in ``default_map``
    should be split into values and type-cast. Structured tuple/list defaults
    and CLI precedence should be preserved.
    """

    @click.command()
    @click.option("--point", nargs=2, type=int)
    def cli(point):
        click.echo(f"point={point!r}")

    # String value in default_map
    result = runner.invoke(cli, [], default_map={"point": "3 4"})
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output.strip() == "point=(3, 4)"

    # Already-structured tuple default_map
    result = runner.invoke(cli, [], default_map={"point": (3, 4)})
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output.strip() == "point=(3, 4)"

    # Already-structured list default_map
    result = runner.invoke(cli, [], default_map={"point": [3, 4]})
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output.strip() == "point=(3, 4)"

    # CLI argument overrides default_map
    result = runner.invoke(cli, ["--point", "10", "20"], default_map={"point": "3 4"})
    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert result.output.strip() == "point=(10, 20)"

    # Invalid type conversion error
    result = runner.invoke(cli, [], default_map={"point": "3 foo"})
    assert result.exit_code != 0
    assert "Invalid value for '--point'" in result.output
